title: INSPI(RED)
exclusionReason: No side-view camera available (standard or optional)
driverAssistBrand: Active Driving Assist (Level 2 ADA, Icona/Armani only; INSPI(RED) does not include ACC + LKA combined)
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with 10.25-inch touchscreen, 7-inch digital cluster, SiriusXM, built-in TomTom navigation, OTA updates, in-car Alexa, Bluetooth, USB.
adasStandard:
Forward-collision warning with automatic emergency braking (highway-speed capable, with pedestrian + cyclist detection), lane-departure warning, lane-keeping assistance, drowsy-driver detection, and a rear-view camera with dynamic gridlines come standard across all MY25 trims.

Sources:
- https://www.fiatcanada.com/en/500e/features-safety
- https://www.capitalone.com/cars/learn/finding-the-right-car/2024-fiat-500e-review-and-test-drive/3512
adasOptional:
On INSPI(RED) (the base trim), blind-spot warning, rear cross-traffic warning, adaptive cruise control, and automatic high beams are NOT standard — these features are standard on Icona and Giorgio Armani trims only, so they are effectively trim-locked rather than option-package upgrades on INSPI(RED).

Sources:
- https://www.fiatcanada.com/en/500e/features-safety
rearViewCameraNotes:
Standard backup camera with dynamic gridlines (steering-angle overlay). Resolution / multi-angle specifics not published by Fiat. Reverse Park Assist (sensor-based) is standard.

Sources:
- https://www.fiatcanada.com/en/500e/features-safety
sideViewCameraNotes: Data unavailable: No 360-degree surround camera or Honda LaneWatch-style side-blind camera is offered on the 500e. Side blind-spot coverage is sensor-based (BSM) on higher trims only — INSPI(RED) lacks even sensor-based BSM as standard.
subscriptionFeatures:
Stellantis Connect Wi-Fi Plus ($17.99/mo after 3-month trial) gates remote start, remote climate prep, remote light/horn activation, and in-car Wi-Fi hotspot. SiriusXM trial (typically 3-12 months) reverts to paid sub. No heated-seat / ADAS / performance subscription-locked features are currently published on the 500e.

Sources:
- https://blog.stellantisnorthamerica.com/2025/07/08/stellantis-introduces-simplified-value-packed-connected-services-for-us-customers/
drmNotes:
Car operates fully without internet for driving functions. Stellantis Connect (renamed from Uconnect Services in July 2025) provides telematics; remote start, climate prep, remote lock/unlock-via-app, and other connected features require Stellantis Connect ONE (10 years included from MY26 onward; MY25 vehicles received older plan terms) or the paid Connect Wi-Fi Plus tier ($17.99/mo after a 3-month trial). OTA software updates are delivered via the Uconnect 5 platform. Owners can opt out of all data transmission by calling 800-800-2813 ('Cancel for Privacy Reasons'), which disables connected features but leaves the car drivable.

Sources:
- https://blog.stellantisnorthamerica.com/2025/07/08/stellantis-introduces-simplified-value-packed-connected-services-for-us-customers/
- https://www.autoguide.com/auto/auto-news/stellantis-rolls-out-two-tier-connectivity-plan-44622460
- https://www.theautopian.com/heres-how-to-stop-your-car-from-sharing-your-data/
killSwitchNotes:
Data unavailable: No impaired-driving-detection hardware/software is currently disclosed on MY25 500e. The IIJA Section 24220 NHTSA rule is still pending (final rule was missed in 2024); MY25 production predates any mandate. Stellantis has not publicly committed to a specific implementation architecture.

Sources:
- https://www.kbb.com/car-news/nhtsas-new-kill-switch-law-approaches-key-deadline/
knownIssues:
MY24-25 500e affected by two compliance recalls: (1) headlight horizontal-aim non-compliance (NHTSA, 2,195 units affected; dealer fix is a mechanical block to prevent horizontal adjustment); (2) seat-belt buckle switch sensor potentially preventing front airbag deployment (NHTSA, owner letters Aug 2024). Slow US sales and large dealer markdowns (up to $15,000 off) have been widely reported; battery/motor reliability data is too thin on the new-gen 500e for a verdict.

Sources:
- https://www.thetruthaboutcars.com/cars/news-blog/recall-alert-2024-2025-fiat-500e-45131968
- https://www.kbb.com/car-news/fiat-recalls-500e-over-headlight-aim/
- https://recharged.com/articles/fiat-500e-recalls-list
recalls:
- NHTSA headlight horizontal-adjustment compliance recall, MY24-25, 2,195 units (https://www.kbb.com/car-news/fiat-recalls-500e-over-headlight-aim/)
- NHTSA seat-belt buckle switch sensor recall, MY24-25, owner letters mailed beginning Aug 27, 2024 (https://recharged.com/articles/fiat-500e-recalls-list)
stateIncentives:
State-specific. CA CVRP was wound down in 2024 but state and utility rebates remain in CO, CT, IL, MA, NJ, NY, OR, RI, VT, and others. Fiat offered a $7,500 lease bonus cash incentive in MY25 to offset the missing federal credit (Italian assembly fails IRA Section 30D NAFTA-assembly requirement).

Sources:
- https://www.efile.com/electric-vehicle-car-tax-credits/
- https://www.fiat500owners.com/threads/understanding-the-tax-credit.154712/
